values.name: Optional
values.value: The server MAY process each batch item in the request either asynchronously (returning an Asynchronous Correlation Value for a batch item) or synchronously. The method or policy by which the server determines whether or not to process an individual batch item asynchronously is a decision of the server and is outside of the scope of this protocol.

values.name: Prohibited
values.value: The server SHALL NOT process any batch item asynchronously. All batch items SHALL be processed synchronously.
